answer: Reaching the ridge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The saffron is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the cipher. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
